out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crates observed used to store foods, equipment, utensils 6 inches off floor.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Purchase proper shelving or dunnage racks.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw gyro beef stored above cooked chicken, ready to eat commercial sauces; observed raw salmon stored above ready to eat vegetables.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved gyro beef and salmon to bottom shelves.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked tomatoes on countertop at 95F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM stated tomatoes are regularly cooked to order and tomatoes were leftover from special order. CFM agreed to use TPHC and discard tomatoes at 6:30PM.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved backflow prevention device installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM agreed to remove splitter on mop sink. EHS will provide approved splitter product informationto CFM, if they require use of one.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed accumulation of mold-like substance on caulking of 3 compartment sink to wall.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean and/or recaulk 3 compartment sink/wall junction.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED LENTIL/BEEF STEW IN WARMER AT 129F. CFM STATED EMPLOYEE ADDED ADDITIONAL STEW TO WARMER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER REHEATING PROCEDURE TO CFM. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE REHEAT STEW ON STOVETOP TO REACH 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT SAUCE AT 48F STORED ON COUNTER. AFTER SPEAKING WITH CFM, CFM STATED SAUCE IS KEPT OUT DURING LUNCH RUSH AND HAS BEEN OUT OF REFRIGERATION FOR 1 HOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM MOVED YOGURT SAUCE BACK TO TRUE GLASS DISPLAY REFRIGERATOR. EHS EXPLAINED YOGURT SAUCE MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW UNLESS THE CFM INTENDS TO USE TPHC FOR THE SAUCES.
